description:
Renew the expired medication prescription for patient 'Martha Kent' (P006).

2. Review her medical history (Medication section) to identify the hypertension medication that recently expired.
3. Note the drug name, dosage, and frequency from the expired order.
4. Create a NEW medication order for her with the EXACT SAME details (Drug, Dosage, Frequency) starting today.
